title: Patch: Ticketed is offered no permanent it cannot stack on
notes: Issue #4835: Ticketed's play (R4665000) is offered and may name only a permanent whose zone a card played onto it may enter (zones::accepts_stack_card): no GIGA (R3546000), none in a Locked zone (R688); ruling R4835000. Engine change in play_choices::legal_selections_for; the catalog is untouched, so the card is claimed with --plays. Classify stage 2 against the base build finds stinkyscape-009 plays differently, and no other card or rule.

player.title: Ticketed is offered only permanents it can stack on
fixes: Ticketed is no longer offered a GIGA permanent, where the play was paid for and Ticketed was lost, nor a permanent in a Locked zone, which a play may not enter.
